title: AgentHarnessConfig
description: Configuration for the agent harness template. Read by the GitHub Action and by the agents at runtime.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the CDK module the editor maintains.

stackName.description: CDK stack name for the preview deploy.

regionalRouting.description: AWS region the AgentCore Managed Harness sessions and Bedrock calls route through.

apiGatewayEndpoint.description: API Gateway endpoint of the orchestrator Lambda. Templated until the operator fills it in post-deploy (per docs/quickstart.md). The dispatch workflow SigV4-signs a POST against this URL; the Lambda calls InvokeHarness against the deployed Managed Harnesses.

editor.description: Bedrock model identifier for the editor agent.

reviewer.description: Bedrock model identifier for the reviewer agent.

iterationCap.description: Max iterations per trigger before the loop terminates with iteration-cap reason.

wallClockCapMinutes.description: Max wall-clock minutes per trigger before the loop terminates with wall-clock-cap reason.

tokenSpendCapUSD.description: Max combined editor+reviewer token spend per trigger before the loop terminates with token-cap reason.

reviewerSeverityThreshold.description: Reviewer findings at or above this severity block the deploy gate.

reviewerPillars.description: AWS Well-Architected pillars the reviewer covers.

tagKey.description: Tag key used to scope preview resources to a session id.

envTagKey.description: Tag key used to mark a resource as belonging to a preview environment.

sweepIntervalHours.description: How often the scheduled sweep runs.

sweepMaxAgeHours.description: Preview stacks older than this are destroyed by the sweep.

sameDiffWindow.description: Window of recent iterations checked for repeated identical diffs.

alternationWindow.description: Window of recent iterations checked for alternating sensor states.

enabled.description: Single disable switch for all Task 2 (fitness-gap-loop) behaviour.

schedule.description: Cron schedule for the scheduled reviewer workflow.

severityThreshold.description: Minimum severity that triggers auto-opening an issue.

duplicateAction.description: Action taken when an open duplicate issue exists.

expiryDays.description: Days before an open auto-opened issue is considered expired for outcome tracking.

enabled.description: Whether the gap-closure check runs after deploy on fitness-gap triggers.

reviewerTokenSpendCapUSD.description: Max token spend per scheduled reviewer run.

findingCountDeltaThreshold.description: Threshold for a sudden increase in finding count between runs.

consecutiveRunsThreshold.description: Threshold for the same finding signature appearing across consecutive runs.

versions.description: Single source of truth for all pinned versions (including agentcoreSdk for @aws/agentcore@preview and bedrockAgentCoreSdk for @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-agentcore). The CI check scripts/check-version-drift.ts fails if these diverge from package.json lock files.
